evidence: Modelling PPI evidence class as a relation subtype, rather than as an edge property, improves prediction on both protocols.
observation: Splitting the PPI relation into experimental (735) and predicted (2,622) subtypes over the same 117,477 edges and 69,609 nodes raises RGCN degree-matched 0.282028/0.281726 to 0.284315/0.284265 and fair 0.758574/0.712475 to 0.760365/0.715780, with six relation types instead of five. The later fixed-sampler sweep measured the same arm at -0.0146 macro against policy_context, so the size of the gain depends on the reference graph.
subject: F-97
title: PPI evidence subtypes help both protocols at identical size
